email_subject: Application - UI/UX Designer at Breach Candy Hospital Trust
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the UI/UX Designer position at Breach Candy Hospital Trust. With a background in front-end development and digital design, I have a strong foundation in creating user-friendly and visually appealing digital experiences.

In my role as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application, which gave me direct insight into designing for usability and accessibility in a medical context. More recently, as a freelance web designer, I built and designed websites such as baverok.com and mirook.com from the ground up, focusing on clean layouts, intuitive navigation, and accessible markup. I am proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I regularly use design tools like Figma and Canva to create wireframes and prototypes.

I am eager to bring my skills in user-centered design and my technical understanding to your team, helping to create simple, efficient, and enjoyable digital experiences for your users.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the UI/UX Designer position at Breach Candy Hospital Trust. With a background in front-end development and digital design, I have a strong foundation in creating user-friendly and visually appealing digital products. My experience in healthcare technology and web design has equipped me with the skills to design interfaces that are both functional and attractive.

As a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript. This role required a deep understanding of user needs and the ability to implement designs that enhance usability and accessibility. I collaborated closely with the development team to ensure that the interface was intuitive and efficient, directly contributing to a better user experience for healthcare professionals and patients.

More recently, as a freelance web designer, I have built and designed websites such as baverok.com and mirook.com from the ground up. For baverok.com, I designed a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, structured data, and accessible markup, ensuring a seamless and engaging user experience. For mirook.com, I implemented JSON-LD schema and ran iterative technical audits to improve search visibility and usability. These projects have honed my skills in wireframing, prototyping, and creating layouts that prioritize user-centered design.

I am proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and I regularly use design tools like Figma and Canva to create wireframes and prototypes. My technical background allows me to communicate effectively with developers and product teams, ensuring that designs are both feasible and aligned with business goals. I am passionate about improving usability and accessibility, and I believe that simple, efficient, and enjoyable digital experiences are key to user satisfaction.

I am eager to bring my skills and enthusiasm to Breach Candy Hospital Trust, where I can contribute to creating digital experiences that truly meet the needs of your users. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
